title: Our team currently manages meeting rooms using a shared spreadsheet. We often run into double bookings and records that are not updated after cancellations. Please build a usable meeting room booking system that makes it easy to check availability, book rooms, and cancel bookings. Show me what you have built and explain how to use it. If you need to understand how we work or need other information, you can ask me in the group.
summary:
## What was built

A browser-based meeting room booking web app that replaces the shared spreadsheet. It prevents double bookings and keeps records current after cancellations.

- **Availability check** — pick a date and see all 5 rooms (A–E) with their booked slots marked.
- **Booking** — choose room, date, start/end (30-minute slots, 08:00–18:00), booker name and title, then click Book. Overlapping bookings for the same room/date are hard-blocked with a clear conflict message.
- **Cancellation** — in the booking list, enter the same booker name used to create the booking and click Cancel. Only the original booker can cancel; a wrong name is rejected and the booking is retained.
- **Persistence** — bookings are saved in browser localStorage under key `meetingRoomBookings.v1` and survive page reloads. Storage read/write failures are handled gracefully (no phantom bookings, no data loss).

## How to use it

1. Open `app/index.html` in a desktop browser — no build step and no server required.
2. To check availability, select a date; each room block shows its booked slots.
3. To book, fill in room, date, start time, end time, your name and a title, then click Book. If the slot overlaps an existing booking you will see a conflict message and nothing is saved.
4. To cancel, find your booking in the list, type the same booker name you used when booking, and click Cancel.
